notes: Account background: internal search & recommendations platform for a large global retail/marketplace business. Combine product catalog, help center, UGC and logs into unified semantic index.
Indexing scale: target production footprint 300M-800M vectors; expect 50-200M embedding updates/day during reindex windows.
Primary asks: minimize unit cost for high-throughput semantic reranking while keeping 95th p99 end-to-end latency (ANN + reranker) <200ms for typical queries.
Throughput requirements: steady-state 2k qps, burstable to 100k qps (short windows). Interested in autoscaling + burst pool options.
Current architecture: mixed — Pinecone for ANN proto, Redis for hot-cache, separate GPU fleet for reranker. Looking to consolidate to reduce ops burden.
Model preferences: open-models, quantized rerankers (8-bit/4-bit) if verified. Interested in Redwood-run quantized variants and kernel/compilation optimizations.
Technical constraints: must support persistent KV cache across replicas, deterministic fallback routing, and zero-downtime live reindexing for catalog updates.
Customer quote (CTO, 2026-02-11): 'We cannot accept >$0.001 per user query at scale — need systematic unit cost planning and clear cost levers.'

POC plan agreed: three-phase — (1) ANN latency & throughput at 100M vectors, (2) rerank latencies with quantized model on Dedicated GPUs, (3) long-run cost simulation and Optimize recommendations against real telemetry.
P0 metrics defined in discovery: aim for ANN lookup cost <$0.0004/query and full rerank including model cost <$0.002/query; p99 (ANN+rerank) <200ms.
Security: SOC2 required; KMS integration mandatory; SAML SSO + SCIM; need audit logs shipped to customer SIEM and 13-month retention of access logs.
Data residency: EU region required for EU customers; subset of data must be on-prem in Germany for regulated sellers.
Operational asks: token-level cost breakdowns per route, per-model profiling, and per-request tracing to attribute cost across embed+ANN+rerank stages.
POC dataset: initial sample set 50M vectors for stage 1; target 500M for stage 2. Will provide anonymized snapshots + production-like traffic replay.
Finance note: internal procurement wants committed discount thresholds documented; finance team flagged need for committed RUs before final approval.
Vendor shortlist: evaluating Redwood to replace multi-vendor stack (Pinecone + custom rerank fleet) to reduce operational overhead and snap-in caching/batching optimizations.
Operational risk: high ingestion churn during reindex windows (bulk updates) — must validate continuous batching and cost behavior under heavy writes.
Integration items: security questionnaire outstanding (sections on KMS/HSM), legal review for on-prem deployment contract templates.
CSM ask: prepare template dashboard for token-level cost & per-route latency to show to product leadership during exec review.
Open question: acceptable cold-start warmup time for large shards; customer favors graceful degradation with progressive rerank fallbacks.
